They climbed on the tree, laughing and having fun, as they explored up and down. Suddenly, Jane noticed something strange up high. She looked at Peter and said, "Look, what do you think that is?"

Peter hesitated at first and then bravely said, "Let's climb higher and find out!"

So they both climbed up and saw a nest with three eggs! Jane gasped and said, "What a surprise! These eggs are so impressive!" 

But then they both heard a loud screech. They looked around and saw a mother bird screaming at them from the tree branch. Scared, they quickly ran away from the tree.

The twins now had a funny story to tell their parents about the impressive eggs. They laughed and had so much fun on their adventure.

Tim and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to run, jump and slide on the grass and the swings. They had a lot of fun, but they also got very dirty and sweaty.

"Look at your shoes, Lily!" Tim said. "They are so smelly and brown. You need to clean them."

Lily looked at her shoes and made a face. "You are right, Tim. They are smelly and brown. But I don't want to clean them. I want to play more."

Tim shook his head. "No, Lily. You have to clean them. Mommy will be angry if you go home with smelly and brown shoes. Come on, let's go to the fountain and wash them."

Lily sighed. She did not want to go to the fountain. She wanted to play more. But she knew Tim was right. Mommy would be angry if she saw her shoes. So she followed Tim to the fountain.

They took off their shoes and put them under the water. They rubbed them with their hands and tried to make them clean. They splashed each other and laughed. They forgot they were cleaning their shoes. They were having fun.

After a while, they looked at their shoes. They were not smelly and brown anymore. They were wet and shiny. They had completed their task.

"Wow, look at our shoes, Tim!" Lily said. "They are so wet and shiny. We have completed our task."

Tim nodded. He was proud of their work. "Yes, Lily. We have completed our task. Our shoes are wet and shiny. Mommy will be happy."

They put on their shoes and ran back to the park. They played some more until Mommy came to pick them up. Mommy was happy to see them. She was also happy to see their shoes.

"Good job, Tim and Lily!" Mommy said. "You have cleaned your shoes. They are not smelly and brown anymore. They are wet and shiny. You have completed your task."

Tim and Lily smiled. They hugged Mommy and told her about their day. They were happy. They had played, cleaned and completed their task.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Bun-Bun. Bun-Bun loved to play outside in the sunshine and eat carrots. One day, Bun-Bun's mama asked if she wanted to help bake some yummy cookies. Bun-Bun was so excited!

They went into the kitchen and mama got out all the ingredients. Bun-Bun helped mix the dough and put it in the oven to bake. While they waited for the cookies to bake, mama told Bun-Bun a story about a mole who lived underground. Bun-Bun thought it sounded scary, but mama said the mole was very friendly.

Finally, the cookies were done and Bun-Bun got to try one. They were so delicious! Bun-Bun's mama said they were the best cookies she had ever tasted. Bun-Bun was so proud of herself for helping bake them. After they finished eating, Bun-Bun went outside to play again. She looked around and saw a dull grey rock. She picked it up and showed it to her mama. Mama said it was a very dull rock, but Bun-Bun thought it was still pretty cool.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the garden with her toys. One day, she saw a big box on the porch. She asked her mom what was inside. "It's a surprise! We need to unpack it," her mom said.

Lily was so excited to see what was inside. They opened the box and found a hose. "Wow, this is so cool!" Lily said. Her mom showed her how to use it to water the plants.

After they finished, Lily had an idea. "Mom, let's use the hose to make a creative painting!" Her mom smiled and said, "That's a great idea, Lily!" They filled a bucket with water and added some paint. Then, they used the hose to spray the paint onto a big piece of paper.

Lily was so happy with their creative painting. She hugged her mom and said, "I love spending time with you!"

Once upon a time, there was a big ocean with lots of fish. One day, a shark came to the ocean and started to eat all the fish. The fish were scared and they asked the shark to stop, but the shark didn't listen. 

Then, a brave fish came up with a plan to stop the shark. The fish pretended to be dead and the shark came closer to eat it. But when the shark got close, all the other fish jumped out and scared the shark away. 

The fish were happy and they said "please don't come back, Mr. Shark!" And the shark never came back again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who was very naughty. He did not like to listen to his mom and was always getting into trouble. One day he was told he could not go outside to play until he cleaned his room.

The boy got really mad and threw some of his toys. His mom became very angry and said it was time to punish him. She took his favorite clay puppet and hid it somewhere in the house.

The boy was so sad because he could not find his clay puppet. He looked everywhere but it seemed as though it was hidden from him. He even asked his mom with his puppy dog eyes, but she said no.

The boy was so sorry for what he had done and he learned his lesson. From then on he was a very good boy and listened to what his mom said. But sadly he never found his clay puppet!

Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Benny. Benny loved to play in the river with his friends. The river was very noisy because the water splashed and flowed quickly over the rocks. 

One day, Benny's friend asked him to go on an adventure to explore the forest. Benny was excited and agreed to go. But as they walked further into the forest, Benny started to regret leaving the river. He missed the sound of the noisy water and the fun he had with his friends. 

After a while, Benny's friend noticed that he was sad and asked him what was wrong. Benny explained that he missed the river and wished he was back there. His friend understood and suggested they go back to the river. Benny was overjoyed and they quickly made their way back. When they arrived, Benny felt happy again and knew he never wanted to leave the river for too long.

Once upon a time there was a naughty girl called Lily. She was very rude to her mum and always shouted at her. 

One day, Lily was rushing around the kitchen, being very noisy. Her mum warned her to be careful, but Lily didn't listen. Suddenly, she bumped into the cabinet and it fell, smashing on the floor. 

Lily was so scared that she started to cry. Her mum came in and saw what had happened. Even though she was angry, she was kind and she helped Lily to clean up the mess. They spent the rest of the day together and Lily was very happy. 

She had learnt her lesson and she swore to never be so rude ever again. The end.

Once upon a time there was a gifted little girl called Katy. She lived in a small house with her mummy and daddy.

Every night, her daddy would let her sit on his lap and he would tell her stories about far away places. Katy was always so excited to hear the stories and asked lots of questions.

One night, her daddy told her about a special head that could move mountains. Katy couldn't believe there was a head that could do that!

The next day, Katy and her daddy went to the park and daddy let her try out how strong she was.

She concentrated really hard and tried to make the top of the slide move. After lots of tries, it started shaking a little bit!

Katy was so pleased and she knew she was gifted. Her daddy was so proud and gave her a big hug. 

From then on, Katy new that anything was possible with hard work.

One day, a little girl was playing in her garden when she noticed a funny cloth under the bush. "What's that?" she said. She reached out to grab the cloth, but a strange voice said "Stay!" The girl was scared and stepped back. She then saw an old man walking toward her.

The old man could tell the little girl was scared, so he said "It's alright. I'm not here to hurt you. I am ignorant of this cloth, and need help finding out what it is." The girl saw that the man was kind, so she smiled and said she would try to help.

The girl and the old man began to investigate the strange cloth. To her surprise, the girl uncovered an ancient treasure chest. She turned to the old man and saw his delight.

He thanked the little girl for trusting him with her help. He said "This chest is more valuable then I could have ever imagined." As the old man began to open the chest, he told the girl that staying kind and courageous was worth more than any treasure.

Once upon a time, there lived a cool boy named Max. Every day, Max would jog around the park with his parents. He loved to jog! One day, Max spotted something shiny in the park - it was an iron! He ran over to it and his mom said, "Max, that's an iron. It's very hot, so you mustn't touch it!" But Max was so curious so he touched it anyway. "Ouch!", he exclaimed. His parents laughed and gave him a cool hug. 

"Kiddo, that is an iron and it is hot!", his dad said. Max was so surprised. His dad then said, "Let's just jog together and a cool iron can be our new best friend, ok?" 

Max smiled and they all began to jog again, with a cool iron as their new friend.

Once there was a little boy called Jack who loved to play with his friends. One day they were playing in the garden when Jack stepped on his friend's toy. His friend was very sad and shouted at Jack, saying "You broke my toy!" Jack felt very sorry and said he was so sorry. He asked to his friend to forgive him.

His friend asked him why he should forgive him. Jack thought and thought and then had an idea. He said "I know, let's have an event and make it fun for everyone. That way you can forgive me." 

His friend thought it was a funny idea, so they started planning the event. They invited all of Jack's friends to join in and have fun. 

Everyone had a great time and Jack's friend, seeing how happy Jack was, agreed to forgive him. 

Everyone enjoyed the event and Jack was so happy that he and his friends were able to forgive each other and have fun.

Jimmy wanted to mail his toy plane to his friend across the country. He was a bit frightened because he had never done it before. Mommy helped him package up the plane so it would be safe. They took it to the post office, which was a bit scary for Jimmy.

The postman gave them a stamp and showed them where to put it on the package. Mommy talked to the postman and explained where to send the package.

The postman put the package into a big metal box and told Jimmy his plane was on its way. Jimmy said goodbye to his plane and waved as he watched it go through the machine.

Soon, Jimmy was excited to get a letter in the mail from his friend and sure enough, a few days later they received it! His friend thanked him for the plane and said it was the best present ever.

Jimmy felt so relieved that his plane had made it safe and sound, and felt so proud that he had mailed it all on his own.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat honey on her toast every morning. One day, her mom took her to a special store where they sold unique toys. 

Lily looked around and saw a big teddy bear and a shiny toy car. She wanted both but her mom said she could only choose one. 

Lily thought for a moment and said, "I choose the teddy bear because it's soft and cuddly." Her mom smiled and they bought the teddy bear. 

As they walked out of the store, Lily hugged her new teddy bear and said, "I love my unique teddy bear and I can't wait to show it to my friends!"

Once there was a little girl named Abigail, who loved to make things. One day, Abigail found a post in her brother's room. She wanted to take it and make something with it. She asked her brother, "Can I have the post?" but he said, "No, it's mine!" Abigail was sad.

Then she had an idea. She went to her mom and dad and asked them for help. She said, "Can you make the post into something for me?" Her parents smiled and said, "Yes, of course we can!"

So Abigail's parents made the post into a tight swing for her. Abigail was so excited, she said, "Thank you so much, Mom and Dad!" She couldn't wait to try out her new swing. 

Abigail had so much fun with her new swing. The tight strings kept her safe as she swung higher and higher. Now she could play with her new swing every day. And she was grateful to her parents for helping her make it.

Jim and Jane were brother and sister. They were walking down the path when Jim started to complain. "Why can't I ever do anything?" Jane said nothing, she was very dependable. 

They kept walking until they reached a bridge. Jim stopped, scared. There was a big gap in the bridge and Jim didn't want to go across. Jane looked at her brother and said "Come on Jim, I won't let you fall. I'm dependable." 

Jim shook his head nervously and stepped onto the bridge. The bridge started to creak and Jim jumped back, scared. Jane said, "It's alright, I'm here. Don't worry." 

But it was too late. With a loud crunch, the bridge collapsed and Jim fell into the river below. Jane screamed and tried to catch her brother but she was too late. 

Jim was gone. Jane was devastated. She had always been so dependable, but she hadn't been able to save her brother.

Once upon a time, there was a skeleton that wanted to have a bit of fun. 

He grabbed a stick from the ground and started to make a loud noise. He jumped around and laughed with joy while the stick made a loud scratching sound. 

Suddenly, out of nowhere, a little 3 year old boy heard the noise. He looked around, trying to find the source of the noise. He spotted the skeleton and was a bit scared. 

The skeleton grabbed onto the boy's hand and said, "Don't be scared! Let's play together!" The boy was suddenly filled with joy. 

Together they ran around, making loud noises with the stick. Eventually, they both got tired and the skeleton said goodbye and left. 

The boy was so happy that he had met the skeleton and had so much fun. He ran to his mom and told her all about his adventure with the skeleton. She smiled and hugged him, happy to hear about his new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside. One day, it was very wet outside because it had rained. Tim put on his boots and went out to play in the wet grass. 

Tim saw a big box in the yard. He was very excited to unpack the box. Inside the box, he found a long stick. Tim was happy to find the stick. He picked it up and started to play with it.

He used the stick to draw in the wet dirt. He made a big sun and a happy face. Tim played with the stick all day long. When it was time to go inside, Tim took the stick with him. He knew he would have more fun with it the next day.

The farmer was ready to spray his field. He grabbed a big red tank filled with the liquid and carefully placed it on his back. As he started walking towards the field, he saw his little daughter watching him.

"Daddy, where are you going with that tank?", the little girl asked.

"I'm going to spray my field so that new plants can grow!", the farmer exclaimed with a happy smile.

The little girl smiled too and ran to her dad's side. She was ready to help.

The farmer pointed the big sprayer at his head and started pressing the button. The liquid came out in a fine mist and covered the whole field.

The little girl was amazed. "Did you spray all the field with that tank?", she asked.

"Yes, I did!", the farmer replied proudly.

The little girl was so excited and wanted to help more.

The farmer took out a smaller sprayer from his pocket and gave it to his daughter. He showed her how to use it and said, "Now you try. You can help me spray the field too!".

The little girl was so happy. She smiled and started spraying the field with the small sprayer. It made her so proud to help her daddy with the field!

Nina was very excited. She had two big pieces of wood that she wanted to stick together with glue. She said to her friend, "Let's climb up and glue these together!" So they both climbed up their chairs and onto the table.

Nina's friend was a bit scared but Nina was full of energy and enthusiasm. She picked up the bottle of glue and spread it on the rough surfaces of the wood. Then they pressed the two pieces together tightly and waited for the glue to dry.

When the glue was dry they climbed down from the table and saw that they had made a strong connection. They beamed with pride as they admired their special creation.

Nina said, "Look how well we glued it together. Our connection is very strong!"

Her friend agreed and added, "Yes! It's strong and it feels very rough!"

Nina and her friend were very happy with the result of their hard work. They had climbed up to create something special!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and teddy bear. One day, Lily's mom brought home a new doll for her. 

Lily admired the new doll. "She's so pretty!" said Lily. "I love her little dress and her curly hair." 

Lily's mom measured the new doll to make sure she would fit in Lily's dollhouse. "She's just the right size," said Lily's mom. 

Lily played with her new doll all day and even took her to bed with her at night. "I love my new doll," said Lily. "She's my favorite little friend." 

The end.

One day, there was a brave man. He saw an arrow in the sky and knew he had to take it down. He raced off to grab his bow and arrow. Then, he took aim and fired.

The arrow sailed through the air and hit its target. Everyone was impressed! The brave man was happy and congratulated himself on his impressive shooting. 

But then, everything changed. The arrow had hit a tree and started a huge fire!

It quickly spread and threatened to take over the town. The brave man worried and realized he must have done something wrong.

The brave man tried to put out the fire, but he knew it was too late. He had been too careless and the town had suffered. 

The moral of the story is to always be careful. Bad things can happen if you are not careful. Don't let your pride and ambition get the better of you.

Lily and Max are friends. They like to play with blocks. They have many blocks of different colors and shapes. They can make patterns with the blocks. A pattern is when you put the same things in a row, like red, blue, red, blue.

One day, Lily and Max are playing with blocks. Lily wants to make a pattern with red and blue blocks. She looks for red and blue blocks in the pile. But Max has taken all the red blocks. He is making a big tower with them.

"Max, can I have some red blocks?" Lily asks. "I want to make a pattern."

"No, these are my red blocks. You can use the other colors." Max says. He does not want to share.

"But I need red blocks for my pattern. Please share with me." Lily says. She feels sad.

Max thinks for a moment. He likes Lily. He does not want to make her sad. But he also likes his tower. It is very tall and tough. Tough means it does not fall down easily.

"OK, Lily. I will share with you. You can have some of my red blocks. But you have to give me some of your blue blocks. Then we can both make patterns and towers." Max says.

Lily smiles. She is happy. She gives Max some of her blue blocks. Max gives Lily some of his red blocks. They say thank you to each other. They start to make patterns and towers with the blocks. They have fun. They are good friends. They know how to share.

Ben and Lily were playing in the barn. They liked to make forts with the hay and pretend they were knights and princesses. Ben had a wooden sword and Lily had a paper crown.

"Ha! I have you now, evil dragon!" Ben shouted, as he swung his sword at Lily. "Surrender or I will poke you!"

Lily giggled and ran away. She hid behind a pile of hay and threw some at Ben. "Never! I am the queen of the hay and you are a silly knight!"

Ben chased Lily around the barn, dodging the hay. He was having fun, but he also wanted to win. He saw Lily peek out from behind a hay bale and ran towards her.

"Got you!" he said, as he grabbed her arm. "Now you have to surrender!"

Lily pouted and shook her head. "No, I don't! Let me go!"

Ben frowned and pulled her closer. "Yes, you do! You are the dragon and I am the hero!"

Lily kicked and squirmed. "No, I'm not! You are the dragon and I am the hero!"

They both started to yell and tug at each other. They did not hear the door open and their mom come in.

"Hey, hey, hey!" their mom said, in a mild voice. "What is going on here? Why are you fighting?"

Ben and Lily stopped and looked at their mom. They felt ashamed and sorry.

"We were playing, mom," Ben said.

"But he wanted me to surrender and I didn't want to," Lily said.

Their mom smiled and hugged them both. "I see. Well, playing is good, but fighting is not. How about you both surrender and say sorry to each other?"

Ben and Lily nodded and hugged each other. "Sorry, Lily," Ben said.

"Sorry, Ben," Lily said.

Their mom kissed them and said, "That's better. Now, how about we go inside and have some cookies and milk?"

Ben and Lily cheered and followed their mom. They forgot about the hay and the sword and the crown. They were happy to be friends again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jo. Jo was excited because she was going to a faraway place. Her mommy gave her a big passport and showed her lots of pictures inside it.

Jo packed all her things into her suitcase and was ready to go. She waved goodbye to her mom and dad and got on the plane.

When she landed, it was really dry. Jo wanted to learn all about the place, so she grabbed her passport and started to study. She read all of the maps and facts and really enjoyed it! 

Jo had the best time exploring and studying. She took lots of pictures and learned so much. Soon the sun started to set and it was time to go home. Jo had her passport in her hand as she got back on the plane and waved goodbye to her new friends. She was so happy with all the new things she had learned!

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She wanted to belong somewhere, but didn't know where.

One day Lucy went to the park. There was a big building with a lot of people wearing the same clothes and carrying a staff. They were all very loud and friendly.

Lucy thought to herself, "I want to belong here". So she walked up to the friendly people and asked if she could join them.

The people laughed and said, "Yes, of course you can join us. We'd love to have you."

Lucy was delighted. She was now a part of something and belonged with the friendly people who carried the staff. She was so happy that she gave them a big hug.

The friendly people hugged Lucy back and said, "Welcome to our family!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and teddy bears. One day, she was playing with her favorite doll when she accidentally broke its handle. She felt upset and didn't know what to do.

Her mom saw her and asked, "What's wrong, Lily?" Lily showed her the broken handle and said, "I don't know how to fix it. I'm upset."

Her mom said, "It's okay to feel upset, but let's try to settle down and think of a solution. Maybe we can glue the handle back together."

Lily helped her mom glue the handle back on the doll and it was as good as new. Her mom told her, "Remember, when something breaks, we can always handle it and find a way to fix it." Lily smiled and hugged her mom, happy that her doll was fixed and she had learned a valuable lesson.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to hop around in the grass and play with his friends. One day, Benny found a big root sticking out of the ground. He thought it looked like the perfect spot to hide from his friends during their game of hide-and-seek.

Benny hopped over to the root and crawled underneath it. It was a tight squeeze, but he managed to fit. The root was the perfect hiding spot, and none of his friends could find him. Benny was so happy he found the perfect hiding spot.

As the sun started to set, Benny realized it was time to go home. He hopped out from under the root and made his way back to his burrow. Benny was tired from all the hopping and playing, but he was happy because he found the perfect hiding spot.

Once upon a time, there was a squirrel named Sammy. Sammy was looking for a huge acorn to eat. He ran through the forest and saw a big tree with lots of acorns. 

He climbed up the tree and saw a ladybug. "Hello, ladybug! Have you seen a huge acorn around here?" Sammy asked. 

The ladybug replied, "Yes, I saw a huge acorn speed by just a few minutes ago! It rolled down the hill and into the river." 

Sammy was sad because he couldn't find the huge acorn. But then he saw a little acorn and decided to eat it instead. It was delicious!

Once there was a stick. It was flexible, so it was always moving. It was so excited! It wanted to explore the world.

One day, the stick saw a river. The stick wanted to see what was on the other side of the river, so it jumped in. But it sank in the water! The stick was not a good swimmer.

It started to cry and suddenly a friendly bird swooped in. The bird picked up the stick and flew across the river. The stick dried in the warm sunshine on the other side.

The stick was happy. It started exploring and it met lots of new friends. It was an adventure! The stick was flexible and bouncy and it had lots of fun. 

Finally, when the sun was setting, the stick climbed back into the river. It floated to the other side and was happy to be home.

Once upon a time, there was an enormous goat. He lived in a quiet field with his friends. Every day, the goat would take a relaxing stroll around the field. He enjoyed the sunshine and the wind on his fur.

One day, the goat noticed something strange in the middle of the field. It was an enormous tree! He had never seen anything that big before.

The goat decided to get closer and take a better look. He walked very slowly until he was underneath the enormous tree. He was so excited!

The goat decided to lay down and relax in the shade of the tree. The warmth of the sun and gentle breeze felt so nice. He looked up at the enormous branches of the tree and enjoyed the moment.

The goat stayed there for a long time, until he was so relaxed that he fell asleep. Eventually, he woke up and ran back to his friends in the field. Every day afterwards, the goat would come back to the enormous tree - to relax and explore beneath its branches.

Harry and his mommy had a special day. They went to the camp to perform. Harry was excited and he could hardly wait!

When they arrived, Harry saw a bunch of people with instruments. He saw drums and guitars and a big microphone. He was so excited and he couldn't believe his eyes!

Mommy gave him a hug and helped him get ready for the performance. They sang together and it sounded so sweet. Everyone in the camp joined in and sang louder. Harry was so proud.

But the performance was over too soon. When it was time to go, Harry was a bit sad. He felt a bit bitter that the performance was over. But Mommy said they could come back again soon, and Harry smiled with joy.

Sara and Ben were playing in the park with their furry dog, Spot. They liked to run and throw a ball for Spot to catch. But one day, Spot ran too fast and did not see a big rock on the path. He hit the rock with his paw and yelped in pain.

"Spot, are you okay?" Sara asked, running to him. She saw that his paw was bleeding and he was limping.

"Let's take him to the vet," Ben said. "The vet can heal his paw and make him feel better."

They picked up Spot and carried him to their car. Sara held him in her lap and tried to calm him down. "Don't worry, Spot. We love you and we will help you," she said.

At the vet, they waited for their turn. Spot was still whimpering and licking his paw. Sara and Ben felt sad and scared for him. They hoped the vet could fix his paw.

Finally, the vet called them in. She looked at Spot's paw and said, "He has a small cut, but nothing serious. I will clean it and put a bandage on it. He will heal in a few days. He is a brave and lucky dog."

Sara and Ben smiled and thanked the vet. They hugged Spot and gave him a treat. Spot wagged his tail and licked their faces. He was happy to have such good friends. They went back to the car and drove home. They decided to play a quieter game with Spot until his paw was healed. They loved their furry dog very much.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat. The cat wanted to go to the theater. Every day she asked the same question: "Can I go to the theater?".

One day, her mom said: "Yes, you can go. But first let's cook something."

The cat was so excited. She quickly ran to the kitchen and saw the mom already cooking. She helped her mom with her cooking and before they knew it, they had made a delicious cake.

"Yummy!", said the cat, and she enjoyed the cake with her mom.

Afterwards, they put on their coats and went to the theater. The cat was so excited! She looked all around, feeling so happy.

At the end of the day, the cat said: "I had such a wonderful time. Can we come back to the theater soon?" 

Her mom said: "Yes, we can come back soon. It was a really fun day".

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to help her mommy in the kitchen. One day, her mommy gave her an apron to wear. It was pink and had a picture of a cupcake on it. Lily loved it!

They were making cookies for a party that night. Lily wanted to decorate the cookies with sprinkles. She put lots of sprinkles on each one. When they were done, they looked so pretty. 

Later, at the party, Lily saw a lady who was deaf. She couldn't hear the music or the people talking. Lily felt sad for her. She gave her a cookie and smiled. The lady smiled back and hugged Lily. It made her feel happy inside.

Lily was a little girl who liked to play with dolls. She had many dolls, but her favorite was Queen Rose. Queen Rose had a pink dress, a shiny crown and long hair. Lily loved to comb her hair and make her talk.

One day, Lily went to the park with her mom and Queen Rose. She saw some other kids playing with balls and bikes. They looked like they were having fun. Lily wanted to join them and make new friends.

She asked her mom, "Can I play with them, please?"

Her mom said, "Sure, honey, but be careful and don't lose Queen Rose. She is very special to you."

Lily nodded and ran to the other kids. She said, "Hi, I'm Lily. Can I play with you?"

The other kids looked at her and laughed. They said, "No, you can't. You are too little and you have a silly doll. We don't like dolls. We like balls and bikes. Go away!"

Lily felt sad and hurt. She said, "But I want to play with you. Please, let me join. Queen Rose is not silly. She is a queen. She is very popular and nice."

The other kids laughed louder. They said, "A queen? Ha ha ha! That's a stupid name for a doll. She is not popular. She is ugly and boring. Watch this!"

One of the kids grabbed Queen Rose from Lily's hands and threw her in the air. Queen Rose flew high and then fell on the ground. Her dress ripped, her crown broke and her hair tangled. Lily screamed and ran to get her. She picked her up and hugged her. She cried, "Queen Rose, I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. You are my best friend. I love you."

The other kids kept laughing and pointing at her. They said, "Look at her. She is crying over a doll. What a baby. Go home, baby. You don't belong here."

Lily felt very bad. She wished she never tried to join them. She wished she stayed with her mom and played with Queen Rose. She ran back to her mom and showed her what happened. Her mom was angry and sad. She said, "Oh, Lily, I'm sorry. Those kids were very mean and rude. They should not have done that. Queen Rose is a beautiful doll and you are a wonderful girl. Come on, let's go home and fix her. We don't need them. We have each other."

Lily nodded and snuggled with her mom and Queen Rose. She said, "Thank you, mom. I love you. And I love Queen Rose. She is still my favorite."

The end.

"Quack! I am a duck!" Lily says.

They laugh and giggle. They have fun with the hat.

Then, they see a man walking towards them. He is smiling. He has a big bag. He is a clown. He works at the circus.

"Hello, kids!" he says. "I see you like my hat. It is amazing, isn't it?"

"Yes, it is!" Tom and Lily say.

"Would you like to join me at the circus?" he asks. "You can see more amazing things there. You can see animals, acrobats, and balloons. You can even wear my hat if you want."

"Really?" Tom and Lily say. "Can we?"

"Sure, why not?" he says. "But you have to ask your parents first. They are waiting for you over there."

Tom and Lily look at their parents. They wave and call them. They tell them about the clown and the circus. Their parents agree to go with them.

"Yay!" Tom and Lily say. "We are going to the circus!"

They follow the clown to his car. They put on the amazing hat. They are excited and happy. They are going to join the circus.

One day, Jack saw a bottle on the ground. He wanted to pick it up but he was too lazy. He decided to ignore it and just keep walking. But then he heard a noise. It was coming from the bottle. Jack was curious, so he stopped to take a closer look. Inside the bottle was a little bird! Jack was so excited. He wanted to take the bird out, but it was stuck inside the bottle. Jack tried to ignore the bird, but he couldn't help himself. He wanted to help the bird, so he worked until he finally got it out. The bird thanked Jack and flew away. Jack was happy that he didn't ignore the bottle after all!

Jill liked to help her mom in the kitchen. She wore a pink apron with flowers on it. She felt very proud and happy. She wanted to be a good cook like her mom.

One day, her mom was making a cake for dad's birthday. She told Jill to watch the oven and not to touch anything. She had to go to the store to buy some candles. She said she would be back soon.

Jill nodded and said, "OK, mom. I will be good." She watched the oven and saw the cake rising and smelling sweet. She wondered how it tasted. She was very curious and hungry.

She decided to take a peek at the cake. She opened the oven door a little bit. She saw the cake was brown and fluffy. She reached for a fork to poke it. She did not know the oven was very hot. She burned her hand and dropped the fork. She screamed and cried.

The fork hit the cake and made a big hole in it. The cake deflated and looked ugly. Jill was very scared and sorry. She tried to fix the cake with her fingers. She made it worse. She heard the door slam. Her mom was back.

Her mom saw the mess and was very angry and sad. She shouted at Jill, "What did you do? You ruined the cake! You did not listen to me! You are a bad girl!" She took off Jill's apron and threw it in the trash. She shut the oven door and shut Jill in her room. She did not hug her or kiss her.

Jill felt very bad and lonely. She wished she had not touched the cake. She wished her mom would love her again. She cried and cried. She did not have a good day.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree in a field. The tree was very popular because it had lots of apples. The apples were so juicy and sweet that everyone in the village loved them.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the field to pick some apples. She saw a big basket under the tree and she pulled it towards her. She started to pick the apples and put them in the basket. The apples were so good that she couldn't stop eating them.

As the season changed, the leaves on the tree turned yellow and started to fall. Lily knew that it was time to say goodbye to the apple tree until next year. She looked at the basket full of apples and smiled. She knew that she had enough apples to last her until the next season.

Once upon a time, a mommy and a daddy took their little girl for a ride in their car. They wanted to go to the park and see the swans. The little girl was so happy to see the swans swimming in the pond. They were so pretty with their white feathers.

After watching the swans for a while, the family got back in their car to go home. The little girl loved how the car could drive so fast. She felt like she was flying! Her mommy and daddy told her they had a modern car that could go really fast.

The little girl was so tired from all the fun at the park that she fell asleep in the car. When she woke up, she was back home in her own bed. She dreamed about the swans and the fast car all night long. The end.

Once upon a time there was a lazy cat. He liked to lie in the sun all day long. One day, he was in the middle of taking a nap when he heard a loud noise.

The cat opened one eye slowly to see what was going on. He saw a little bird at the bottom of the garden. The bird was looking up at the cat and said, "Please help me, sir! I have a leak in my nest and I need your help to repair it."

The cat was so surprised by the little bird's request that he jumped out of his nap and said, "My, what a strange request! But, I'm feeling lazy today so I think I'll help you, little bird. Don't worry, I'll fix your leak!"

The cat got up, stretched his paws and followed the little bird to its nest. He examined the nest carefully and saw that the leak was quite easy to fix. The cat worked hard to patch the leak and soon it was done. 

The little bird was overjoyed and thanked the cat for his help. The cat was so pleased to have been able to help the bird that he stretched out again and enjoyed his nap in the sunshine.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to collect shells. She would go to the beach every day to find new ones. One day, she found a beautiful shell that was far away from her. It was so distant that she had to walk a long way to get to it.

When she finally got to the shell, she saw a sign that said "Do not touch". But Lily didn't listen and picked up the shell anyway. Suddenly, a loud noise scared her and she dropped the shell. It broke into a million pieces.

Lily felt very sad and knew she shouldn't have touched the shell. She learned that sometimes signs are there to keep us safe and that it's important to listen to them.

Lila and Ben were going to the beach with Mom and Dad. They were very happy. They had a big bag with toys and snacks. Mom and Dad had a net to catch fish.

When they got to the beach, Mom and Dad said, "Let's unpack the bag and find a good spot." Lila and Ben helped them unpack. They took out a ball, a bucket, a shovel, a towel, and some sandwiches. They left the net in the bag.

Lila and Ben ran to the water. They splashed and played with the ball. They made a sandcastle with the bucket and the shovel. They had a lot of fun.

After a while, they got hungry. They went back to the bag to get the sandwiches. But they saw something strange. The net was gone. They looked around. They saw a big bird flying away with the net in its beak.

"Hey, that's our net!" Ben shouted. "Give it back!"

The bird did not listen. It flew higher and higher. It looked confused. It did not know what to do with the net.

"Mom, Dad, look!" Lila said. "The bird took our net!"

Mom and Dad looked up. They saw the bird and the net. They laughed.

"Don't worry, kids," Mom said. "The bird won't hurt the net. Maybe it thinks it's a nest."

"Or a hat," Dad said.

Lila and Ben laughed too. They ate their sandwiches. They did not mind the bird and the net. They still had a lot of toys and snacks. They still had a lot of fun.

John and Brad were best friends. They loved to play baseball together. Every day, they spent their time in the park swinging the baseball around. Brad was dependable and he could always hit the ball with the bat, no matter how hard it was to do.

One day, Brad was feeling tired and he decided not to swing the baseball. But then, John said to him: "If you don't swing the bat you'll miss the ball and you won't have any fun!" 

Brad thought it over and decided to give it a try. He swung the baseball and it went far away! He was so happy with himself and his friend John was very proud of him.

The moral of the story is that with a little bit of effort, you can achieve anything! It's important to be dependable and to not give up. If you work hard, amazing things can happen.

Once upon a time, two friends were walking in the park. One of them was called Bob and the other was called Sarah.

"What should we do?" asked Sarah.

"Let me explain," said Bob. "I have an idea for a task. It's really useful. We can pick flowers from the garden and make a beautiful flower bouquet!"

Sarah thought this was a great idea. So they started to pick the flowers and made a beautiful bouquet.

 When they finished, they were both really happy with the result. They placed the bouquet and smiled at each other, proud of the task they had completed.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a car that lived in a big garage. She was very alert and always ready for her driver. One day, her driver said, "Let's go for a drive!" So the car drove out of the garage.

She had a wonderful time seeing all the sights. She even drove off the ground for a bit and saw the clouds in the sky.

Finally, it was time to go home. The car drove back to the garage and she was ready for a rest. As she drove back, the car stayed alert just in case.

The end.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, Bird and Fish. They were the best of friends, always together and playing. 

One day, Bird decided to take a stroll through the wild forest. Before he went, he promised Fish that he would be back soon. As he explored the depths of the forest, he saw a lot of exotic creatures. 

Back in Fish's home, Fish was feeling jealous. He was worried that Bird might find another friend while walking in the wild. He was so sad that he felt like he was alone. 

He decided to wait for Bird at the border of the wild. Once Bird returned, Fish ran up to him and said, "I missed you so much. I was worried you would find a new friend in the wild". 

Bird smiled and said, "I would never do that! You're my best friend and nothing can change that". Fish smiled back, feeling relieved that Bird wanted to stay friends. He thanked Bird for never leaving him and for being loyal. 

The two of them ran off hand in hand, ready for their next adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very curious and loved to explore the world around her. One day, she saw a beautiful rose in her garden. She wanted to touch it, but her mother warned her that the rose had thorns and could hurt her.

Lily didn't understand why the rose had thorns, so she asked her mother. Her mother explained that the thorns were there to protect the rose from being eaten by animals. Lily was amazed and thanked her mother for helping her understand.

From that day on, Lily looked at the world with a new understanding. She realized that things that seemed scary or strange might have a purpose. And just like the rose, she too had her own way of protecting herself from harm.

Harry liked to go for walks. He was a small boy, only three years old. Today, he went out for a walk in the meadow. The sun was shining and birds were singing. As he walked, Harry began to whistle.

Harry soon found a beautiful leaf. It was big and green. He picked it up and ran around, making it whistle in the wind. Soon, he felt dizzy from spinning around and around. He dropped the leaf and fell to the ground, laughing and smiling.

Harry lay there for a while, feeling dizzy and happy. Then, he picked up the leaf and started walking again, still whistling his happy tune.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird, who lived in a tree in the forest. He loved to whistle all day long.

One day, he noticed a mailman walking by, who always whistled while he was walking. Little bird thought it sounded lovely and he began to whistle too. 

The mailman heard the little bird's whistle and stopped walking. "What a great whistle! Can you do it again?" he said.

The little bird was very excited and he whistled as loud as he could.

The mailman laughed. "Your whistle is even better than mine!" he said. He then handed the little bird a letter with a dirty stamp on the front. "This letter is for you!" the mailman said. 

The little bird was overjoyed. He thanked the mailman and flew off. He opened the letter and found a big surprise! It was the most wonderful whistle he had ever seen. 

The little bird was so happy, he started to whistle again and again, even louder than before. He whistled all the way back to his tree in the forest, never forgetting the mailman's gift.

Once there was a scientist named Mr. Smith. He was always trying to improve things. He had a special microscope that he used to study very small things. One day, Mr. Smith decided to try to improve his spicy salsa recipe. He put a drop of the salsa on the microscope and looked closely. He saw tiny pieces of pepper and onion and tomato. He made some changes and added some more spicy pepper. Then he looked again and saw the difference. This time the salsa was extra spicy. Mr. Smith was happy with his improved recipe!

Once upon a time there was a fox. He was walking in the wood and he saw a big house. He was curious and he wanted to look inside. He jumped on the porch and he wondered what he'd find. 

He looked around and saw a big orange chair. It was so bright in the sunshine and he loved it. He hopped up and down. He sat on it and bounced. He liked it a lot. 

He looked around and saw some orange flowers in the garden. He wondered where they'd come from. He picked one and smelled it. Mmm, it was so nice. 

The fox ran off but he knew he'd come back and explore some more. He wanted to see what else was on that porch. He was so excited to go back and see!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys. One day, she was playing with her dolls when her brother came in. "Can I play too?" he asked. "Yes, let's play together!" Lily replied.

They played for a while, but then Lily's brother got tired. "I am weak," he said. "I need to rest." Lily thought for a moment and then had an idea. "Let's fill up our tea set and have a tea party!" she said.

Lily's brother smiled and they went to the kitchen. They filled up their tea set with water and then went back to their room. They had a fun tea party and soon Lily's brother felt better. "Thank you for playing with me," he said. "You're welcome," Lily replied. They hugged and then went to bed, happy and tired from their fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to climb things. One day, he saw a big wall and decided to climb it. It was a terrible idea because the wall was too high and Timmy was too little. He tried and tried, but he couldn't climb it. 

Suddenly, Timmy saw a ladder nearby. He climbed up the ladder and onto the wall. It was a scary climb, but he made it to the top. From up there, he could see everything! He saw the trees, the houses, and even a bird flying by. Timmy was so happy that he climbed the wall even though it was a terrible idea. 

When it was time to go home, Timmy climbed back down the ladder and ran to his mommy to tell her all about his adventure. She was so proud of him for being brave and climbing the wall. From that day on, Timmy knew that he could climb anything he put his mind to.

Tom and Sam were brothers who liked to fish. They had a big bucket of worms and a shiny hook. They went to the lake with their dad and threw the hook in the water. They waited for a fish to bite.

Soon, Tom felt a tug on his line. He pulled hard and saw a big fish on his hook. He was very happy and yelled, "Look, dad, I caught a fish!" Sam was jealous and wanted a fish too. He threw his hook in the water again and again, but no fish came.

Then, Sam saw something shiny in the water. He thought it was a fish and grabbed it. But it was not a fish. It was another hook. And it was sharp. It poked Sam's hand and made it bleed. Sam was very frightened and yelled, "Ow, ow, ow, it hurts!"

Dad heard Sam's yell and ran to help him. He saw the hook in Sam's hand and tried to take it out. But it was stuck. Dad said, "We have to go to the hospital, Sam. They will make it better." He picked up Sam and put him in the car. Tom followed with his fish.

But on the way to the hospital, the car broke down. Dad could not start it. He called for help, but no one came. Sam's hand hurt more and more. He cried and cried. Tom felt sorry for Sam and gave him his fish. But Sam did not want the fish. He wanted the hook out of his hand. He was very sad and scared. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a King. He was the ruler of the land and always had a golden crown on his head. Every day he wore his crown, but one day he noticed it was missing! He needed his crown to make him feel like a King. He invited all the people of the land to help him look for it. 

The people looked everywhere, from the tall mountains to the deep blue sea, but the crown was nowhere to be found. Just when he gave up hope, a little girl came up to him with a smile on her face. In her hand was a golden crown! 

The King was so thankful and asked her where she found it. It turns out, the spoiled King's little pet bunny had taken it and hidden it in its burrow! Everyone laughed and the King put his crown back on with a big smile. From that day on, the King always remembered to be careful with his crown - he knew he needed it to be the King of the land.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the mall with her mommy. One day, they went to the mall to buy new shoes for Lily. 

Mommy said, "Lily, we need to park the car first." 

Lily said, "Okay mommy, I'll help you find an easy spot to park." 

They found a spot and got out of the car. Lily held her mommy's hand and they walked to the shoe store. 

Lily tried on many shoes, but they were all too tight. Finally, she found a pair that fit perfectly. She said, "Mommy, these shoes are so easy to walk in!" 

Mommy smiled and said, "I'm glad we found the perfect shoes for you, Lily." 

Lily was very happy and they walked back to the car. On the way home, Lily fell asleep with her new shoes on. It was a great day at the mall!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Ally. Ally was three years old and she loved to shoot. She had a special gun that her daddy had given her for her birthday. She loved to shoot it in the backyard. 

One day, Ally was shooting when she heard a very loud noise. She looked around to see where it was coming from and noticed a man was running towards her. He was rough and shouting her name. Ally was scared and started to cry. 

Then, Ally's daddy came running up to her. He was running fast and looking very angry. He grabbed the gun out of Ally's hands and scolded the man. The man ran away and Daddy held Ally close and hugged her. He then told her to never shoot her gun again unless he was with her. 

Ally was sad, but she felt better knowing Daddy was with her. He told her that every time she wanted to shoot her gun, that's when she could come and find him. She was very happy and smiled. 

From that day on, Ally was careful to only shoot when Daddy was with her. Daddy made sure she was safe and she always had fun when they went shooting together.

Once upon a time there was a rag. It was red and very messy. It flew through the air and it couldn't balance.

The rag was sad because it wanted to stay in the air and balance. It asked for help.

The sun came out and smiled at the rag. It grabbed the rag and used its warmth to make it softer. The rag felt better.

The wind then came and blew the rag. It moved with the wind, finding its balance. The rag was happy and it smiled.

The rag flew through the air, balancing and twirling. It was free and no longer messy. The rag had found its balance and it was so happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, they decided to have a picnic. Lily's mom made sandwiches and put them in a basket. They also had some lovely cupcakes.

When they got to the park, they found a nice spot under a tree. They laid a blanket on the ground and started to eat. Suddenly, Lily's friend Jack dropped his cupcake on the ground. Lily quickly grabbed a napkin and helped him wipe the crumbs off. 

After they finished eating, they went to the pond to see the ducks. It was very cold and the water had turned to ice. They tried to slide on the ice, but it was too slippery. They decided to go home and drink some hot cocoa instead. It was a fun day at the park!

Once there was a old man who went for a walk. He walked with a cane and smiled at everyone he saw. But some people were very nosy. They kept looking and pointing at the old man. This made the old man very sad.

Soon enough he felt tired and stopped to rest for a bit. Then he sat down and closed his eyes. He blinked and opened them again. Right in front of him was a little girl who smiled at him. The old man smiled back.

The little girl said to him, "Hello! What's your name?"

The old man said, "My name is Peter."

The little girl asked, "Why are you so sad?"

"I'm sad because some people are nosy and keep looking at me," replied the old man.

"Don't worry," the little girl said. "I won't be nosy. I just wanted to be your friend!"

The old man smiled. He suddenly felt happy again. He stood up and thanked the little girl.

"Be sure to be kind to everyone," the old man said as he started to walk. He winked at the little girl and waved goodbye. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a bird. He had nowhere to go and felt very lonely. He was empty inside.

One day, he spotted a house through the trees. He flew closer and saw a girl inside, with a big smile. She waved at him and he waved back.

The bird flew closer and the girl opened the window. She held out her hand and the bird sat on it. She said, â€˜I know youâ€™re lonely. Iâ€™m lonely too, sometimes. Letâ€™s be friendsâ€™.

The bird was so happy. He had found a friend. The girl smiled and said, â€˜Letâ€™s go outside and exploreâ€™.

The bird and the girl went outside, hand in hand. They ran and played, laughed and talked. The bird didnâ€™t feel lonely anymore.

From then on, the bird and the girl were best friends. They knew they could always count on each other.

Jewel was a three year old girl. She was very proud of her x-ray she had just had at the hospital. She was so excited that the doctor had taken a picture of the inside of her body.

When Jewel showed her x-ray to her family, they all acted very happy. They all said how proud they were of Jewel for being brave at the hospital.

Jewel smiled and went to show her friends at daycare. At first, none of them knew what an x-ray was, but Jewel acted out what had happened at the hospital. She showed her friends how she had laid still on her back as the doctor took her picture.

When her friends saw the x-ray, they all acted amazed. They all said it was the coolest thing they had ever seen. Jewel was very proud that she could show her friends something so cool. 

The next day at school, Jewel told her teachers all about her x-ray. She was glad she could share her special experience with everyone she knew. And Jewel was so proud that she had been brave enough to get the x-ray in the first place.

Lily was a girl who liked to think. She liked to think about many things, like the sun, the moon, the stars, and the flowers. She also liked to think about her nose. She thought her nose was very strong. She could smell many things with her nose, like cookies, soap, and grass.

One day, Lily went to the park with her mom. She saw a big dog with a long nose. She thought the dog's nose was stronger than hers. She wanted to smell the dog's nose. She ran to the dog and touched its nose with her nose. The dog did not like that. The dog barked and bit Lily's nose. Lily cried and cried. Her nose hurt a lot. It was bleeding and swollen. Her mom took her to the doctor. The doctor said Lily's nose was broken. He put a bandage on her nose. He said she had to be careful with her nose. He said she could not touch other noses with her nose.

Lily was very sad. She did not like her bandage. She did not like her broken nose. She did not like the dog. She wished she did not think about the dog's nose. She wished she did not run to the dog. She wished she did not touch the dog's nose with her nose. She learned a hard lesson. She learned that some noses are not strong. She learned that some noses are not friendly. She learned that some noses are dangerous. She learned that she should not think too much.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play and talk. They talk about toys, animals, colors and more. They talk a lot.

One day, they have a big dinner with their mom and dad. They eat chicken, rice, carrots and salad. They are very full. But they still want dessert.

Mom says, "You can have dessert if you finish your plate and say please." Sara and Ben nod. They finish their plate and say please. Mom smiles and brings dessert. It is a thick chocolate cake with cream and cherries. It looks yummy.

Sara and Ben say, "Wow, thank you, mom!" They take a big bite of the cake. It is sweet and soft. They like it very much. They talk about how good the cake is.

Mom says, "I'm glad you like it. It is a special cake for a special day. Do you know what day it is?" Sara and Ben think. They shake their heads. Mom says, "It is your birthday! You are four years old today!" Sara and Ben gasp. They forgot. They say, "Happy birthday, Sara! Happy birthday, Ben!" They hug each other and mom and dad. They are very happy. They eat more cake and talk more. They have a good birthday.

Once upon a time, there was a bee who lived in a big hive. He was very busy all day long--gathering pollen, flying around the flowers, and building wax to keep the hive warm.

One day while he was flying, he saw something very tall. It was a huge tree! He had never seen anything like it before.

He flew near it and thought, "What a tall tree! I wonder what it's like inside of it." He made a few circles around the tree, but the branches were too high for him to get any closer.

Then, he heard a voice. It said:

"Hi! Who are you?"

The bee was surprised and said, "I'm just out exploring."

The voice said, "Come up and see me! My nest is in the top of the tree!"

The bee thought and then decided to take the adventure. He flapped his wings and flew up to the top, where he saw a beautiful bird's nest. Inside were three eggs, and the bird eggs were just starting to hatch.

The bee was excited and said, "Hello! I'm so glad to meet you!"

The bird said, "Welcome! I'm glad you came to visit."

The bee and the bird became very good friends. The bee taught the baby birds about the hive, and the bird taught the bee about the tall tree.

Ben and Lily were best friends. They liked to play together and share their toys. One day, they found a big jar of red sauce in the kitchen. They did not know what it was, but it looked yummy.

"Let's try some," Ben said. He opened the jar and dipped his finger in the sauce. He licked his finger and made a funny face. "Ow, ow, ow! This sauce is spicy! It hurts my tongue!"

Lily laughed at Ben. She did not believe him. She thought he was joking. She wanted to try the sauce too. She dipped her finger in the jar and licked it. She also made a funny face. "Ow, ow, ow! You were right, Ben! This sauce is spicy! It hurts my tongue too!"

They ran to the sink and drank some water. They felt better, but they were still sad. They had wasted the sauce and made a mess. They heard their mom coming home. They were scared. They knew they had done something bad.

"Ben, Lily, what have you done?" their mom asked. She saw the jar and the sauce on the table and on their faces. She was angry. She told them that the sauce was for dinner and that they should not touch things that were not theirs. She said they had to clean up the mess and go to their rooms.

Ben and Lily felt sorry. They said they were sorry and that they would not do it again. They asked their mom to forgive them. Their mom said she loved them, but they had to learn from their mistake. She said they had to promise to be good and listen to her.

Ben and Lily nodded. They said they promised. They hugged their mom and said they loved her too. They cleaned up the mess and went to their rooms. They learned that spicy sauce was not for them and that they should not be greedy and curious. They learned that promise was a big word and that they had to keep it. They learned that will was a good thing and that they had to use it to be good. They learned that being good made their mom happy and that made them happy too.

Sam and Lily were young and liked to play with toys. They had many toys in their room, but they did not like to put them away. Their room was messy and their mom was not happy.

One day, mom gave them a new toy. It was a magic wand that could make things shrink or grow. She told them to be careful and not use it on themselves or each other. She said they could only use it on their toys and only in their room.

Sam and Lily were excited and wanted to try the magic wand. They took turns making their toys shrink and grow. They had fun and laughed a lot. They made their teddy bear very big and their car very small. They made their doll very small and their ball very big.

But they forgot to listen to mom. They started to use the magic wand on each other. Sam made Lily's hair shrink and Lily made Sam's nose grow. They thought it was funny and did not stop. They made each other's arms and legs and ears and eyes shrink and grow.

Soon, they looked very silly and strange. They did not look like themselves anymore. They looked like messy monsters. They were scared and sad. They wanted to be normal again. They tried to use the magic wand to fix each other, but they did not know how. They made things worse.

They heard mom coming to their room. They hid under the bed and hoped she would not see them. They wished they had listened to mom and not used the magic wand on each other. They wished they had put away their toys and not made their room messy. They wished they had been good and not bad. They learned their lesson.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl. Every day she would smile and play in the park.

One day, while she was playing, she looked up and saw a raven in the sky. She was very excited and waved at the bird. To her surprise, the raven flew down and landed in her hand.

She was very happy to receive the raven as a gift. She held the raven tightly in her little hands and taken back to her home.

From that day on, the little girl and the raven were friends. They played together in the park every day and were very happy together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved the color pink and always wore a pink dress. One day, she went to the airport to see a big jet take off. The jet was very loud and Lily covered her ears.

After the jet flew away, Lily realized she had lost her favorite toy. She regretted not holding it tightly. She looked everywhere but couldn't find it. She felt sad and started to cry.

Suddenly, a kind man came up to her and gave her back her toy. Lily was so happy and hugged the man. She learned to always hold her things tightly and not regret losing them.

Once upon a time there were two best friends called Jack and Josh. They were playing football in the park one day when Josh accidentally kicked the football too hard. The football flew over the tall trees and Jack was very sad.

"Return my football, please" Jack asked.

"Don't worry" said Josh. "I will return the football to you."

Josh ran away to look for the rare football. He looked near the pond, under the trees and even behind the bushes. Suddenly, a glint from the sun caught his eye. He had found the football!

Josh chuckled as he ran back to Jack.

"Jack, look! I have returned the football to you!" said Josh.

Jack was so happy he could barely contain himself. The two hugged and never forgot the special moment when their friendship was so strong.

Lily and Ben were playing with their toys in the living room. They had a lot of dolls and cars and blocks and books. Lily liked to pretend that she was a queen and Ben was her servant. She wore a crown and a dress and told Ben what to do.

"Ben, display my jewels on the table. They are very shiny and pretty," Lily said.

"Yes, your majesty," Ben said. He took the necklace and the ring and the bracelet that Lily had and put them on the table. He did not like to be a servant, but he wanted to make Lily happy.

But then, a naughty cat came into the living room. The cat saw the jewels and thought they were toys. The cat jumped on the table and knocked over the jewels. The cat played with them and made them roll and bounce on the floor.

"Hey, stop that! Those are mine!" Lily shouted. She ran to the table and tried to grab the jewels from the cat. But the cat was faster and ran away with the necklace in its mouth.

"Come back here, you naughty cat!" Ben shouted. He ran after the cat and tried to catch it. But the cat was clever and hid under the sofa.

Lily and Ben were very sad and angry. They had lost their jewels and their game was ruined. They looked at each other and decided to do something.

"Let's go and tell mom. She will help us get our jewels back," Lily said.

"OK, let's go," Ben said.

They held hands and walked to the kitchen, where mom was making cookies. They told her what happened and asked her to help them.

Mom listened to their story and hugged them. She said, "Don't worry, my darlings. We will find the cat and the jewels. But first, let's have some cookies. They are very yummy and sweet."

Lily and Ben smiled and nodded. They forgot about their jewels and their game for a while. They ate some cookies and thanked mom. They learned that sometimes, things go wrong, but they can always find something good. And they learned that mom was the best queen of all.

Once upon a time, there was a spoiled leopard. He really liked to take big steps through the jungle. His steps were so big that he even scared some of the other animals. He would step over little birds and butterflies without even noticing.

One day, when the leopard was taking his usual big steps, he stepped on a little baby bunny. The leopard felt really bad about hurting the bunny and decided to help him instead. He carefully picked up the bunny and put him gently in a patch of shade with some water and food nearby.

The leopard felt so happy when the little bunny was safe and sound again. He even decided to play with the baby bunny until it gave him a big smile. From then on, the leopard was no longer spoiled but kind and gentle around all the animals in the jungle.

Tim and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a dog. The dog is big and brown. He has a patch on his eye and no hair on his head. He is bald.

"Look, a pirate dog!" Tim says. He runs to the dog. He wants to pet him.

"Wait, Tim!" Ben says. He is scared. He thinks the dog is mean. He stays behind a tree.

The dog sees Tim. He barks loud. He shows his teeth. He does not like strangers.

"Help, Ben!" Tim says. He is afraid. He runs back to Ben.

The dog chases Tim. He is fast. He wants to bite Tim.

"Go away, dog!" Ben says. He picks up a stick. He throws it at the dog.

The dog stops. He sees the stick. He likes sticks. He forgets Tim and Ben. He runs to the stick. He picks it up with his mouth. He wags his tail.

Tim and Ben are safe. They hug each other. They are happy.

"Let's go home, Tim," Ben says. "That dog is not nice."

"OK, Ben," Tim says. "But he is funny. He is a pirate dog."

They laugh. They hold hands. They leave the park. They stay away from the dog.

Lily and Tom were twins who liked to travel with their mom and dad. They had a big car that could fit all their toys and clothes. One day, they went to visit their grandma who lived far away in the mountains.

"Are we there yet?" Lily asked, looking out the window.

"Not yet, sweetie. We still have to cross the bridge and go up the hill," mom said.

Tom was bored and started to play with his toy truck. He made it zoom and beep on his seat. He pretended it was a real truck that could travel fast and loud.

Suddenly, they heard a loud bang. The car stopped and dad got out. He looked at the back of the car and frowned.

"What's wrong, dad?" Tom asked, leaning out the window.

"We have a flat tire, buddy. We need to change it," dad said.

Lily and Tom were frightened. They did not like the sound of the bang. They did not like to be stuck on the road. They did not like to see dad worried.

"Can we help, dad?" Lily asked, trying to be brave.

"Sure, you can. You can stay in the car and keep mom company. And you can look for the spare tire in the trunk. It's a big round thing that looks like a donut," dad said.

Lily and Tom nodded and did what dad said. They found the spare tire and gave it to dad. They watched as dad lifted the car with a jack and replaced the flat tire with the spare one. They cheered when dad finished and got back in the car.

"Good job, dad!" Tom said.

"Thank you, kids. You were very helpful and brave. Now we can travel again and see grandma soon," dad said.

Lily and Tom smiled and hugged dad. They were not frightened anymore. They were happy and excited to travel and see grandma. They looked out the window and saw the bridge and the hill. They knew they were almost there.

Once upon a time, there was a thin wolf. It was walking in the woods, looking for food to eat. All the sudden, the wolf heard a noise. It was a strange noise, like something was crackling. The wolf tried to find what was making the sound. Then, it saw something moving behind a bush.

The wolf slowly crept closer so that it could see what was behind the bush. To its surprise, it saw a little rabbit! The rabbit was looking back at the wolf with big eyes. The rabbit was afraid and stayed locked in place.

The wolf could have run after the rabbit and chased it, but the wolf decided to remain still. To the rabbit's surprise, the wolf just smiled and stayed away. The wolf stayed still until the rabbit jumped away and ran off.

The wolf was happy that it had remained still and allowed the rabbit to escape. The wolf knew that the rabbit was happy now, far away from the woods. In the end, the wolf decided that being nice was always the best option.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toys, especially her magic wand. She would wave it around and make things disappear and reappear. One day, Lily's friend, Timmy, came over to play. 

"Wow, your wand is so cool! Can I play with it?" Timmy asked.

"Sure!" Lily said, handing him the wand. "Just be careful not to destroy anything."

Timmy waved the wand around, but he wasn't as creative as Lily. He accidentally pointed it at her favorite toy and said, "I want this to disappear!" 

Suddenly, the toy vanished into thin air. Lily was so upset that she started to cry. "Why did you do that? That was my favorite toy!" she said.

"I'm sorry, I didn't mean to," Timmy said, feeling bad.

Lily didn't forgive Timmy and they never played together again. The end.

It was early morning, and Mummy was busy getting ready for the day. She had lots to repair around the house.

Mummy opened the cupboard and pulled out a big box of powder. She was very eager to start her work.

Just then, her three-year-old son walked into the room. He saw the box of powder and shouted, "Yay, powder! What can I do with it?"

Mummy smiled and said, "Oh, my clever boy. I'm going to use the powder to repair things around the house. Would you like to help me?"

The little boy was delighted. He said, "Yes, please! I'm very eager to help."

Mummy smiled and together they set about repairing things in the house.

Grandma and Mommy were walking down the hall to the kitchen. Grandma said, "Come on Mommy, you need to keep this hall clean!"

Mommy replied, "I know Grandma, but I have been very busy with the kids all day."

Grandma started to get angry and she urged Mommy to quickly pick up all the toys in the hallway. Mommy didn't want to but she knew she couldn't say no to Grandma.

So, with a deep sigh, Mommy started to pick up the toys one by one. Grandma nodded in approval, urging Mommy to hurry up.

Mommy was so busy picking up the toys that she didn't realize how fast time was flying. Before she knew it, it was almost dinner time and the hall was clean!

Grandma smiled in satisfaction and patted Mommy on the back. "Good job, Mommy! I'm proud of you," she said.

Mommy was so relieved that she had managed to keep Grandma happy. From then on, she made sure to keep the hall clean so Grandma wouldn't get angry.

Once upon a time, there was a big elephant named Ellie. Ellie was walking in the jungle, and she was carrying a heavy log on her back. She wanted to go to the temple, but the log was too heavy for her. 

Suddenly, Ellie saw her friend, a little monkey named Max. Max saw that Ellie was struggling, so he climbed up the log and sat on top of it. Ellie was happy because now the log was lighter and easier to carry. 

As they continued on their journey to the temple, Ellie saw a big puddle of mud in front of them. She said "stop" to Max and they both looked at the mud. Ellie didn't want to get her feet dirty, so Max came up with a plan. He swung from a tree branch and landed on the other side of the mud. Ellie followed Max's lead and they both made it safely to the temple. 

When they arrived, Ellie was so happy to see the beautiful temple. She thanked Max for his help and they both went inside to explore. They saw colorful flowers, shiny statues, and heard peaceful music. Ellie was glad she didn't give up on her journey, and she was grateful for her friend Max.

Once upon a time, there lived a goat. One day, when the goat was out grazing in the field, something strange happened. Suddenly, a different looking goat appeared. The different goat was bigger than the first goat and it had a lot more hair.

The first goat wasn't sure what to do. She felt scared and tried to run away. But no matter where she ran, the different goat followed her. The first goat was feeling very scared and alone.

Just as the first goat thought the different goat was going to catch her, the most unexpected thing happened. Suddenly, a group of goats appeared from nowhere. They had the same color hair as the first goat and chattered away to each other.

The other goats surrounded the first goat and faced the different goat. With their presence, the different goat started to back away. It soon disappeared and never came back again.

The first goat felt relieved and safe. She thanked the other goats and they all went back to the field to graze and play. From then on, the first goat always knew that she could count on her fellow goat friends when she needed help.
